name: The Writers Room | Episode 1 | Ft. Vikramaditya Motwane & Avinash Sampath
description:
Welcome to The Writers Room where all things writing are spoken about. 

In the first episode, you hear the writers of CTRL-  Vikramaditya Motwane, Avinash Sampath and Sumukhi Suresh talk about what went behind writing the movie, the bottomless pit of writing as a skill and the trauma of networking.
